About us JUNA is on a mission to #electrifyroadfreight. Founded in
2023, we’ve had a strong start and have already deployed a
significant fleet of heavy-duty electric trucks in Europe. Our
innovative business model makes it easy and low-risk for carriers to
shift to electric logistics by offering electric trucks as a service,
a flexible pay-per-kilometer pricing structure, and access to
guaranteed utilization from large shippers. As a joint venture between
industry leaders Scania and sennder, JUNA gives customers access to
premium electric trucks and reliable revenue through access to
priority green freight. Your mission As JUNA’s (Senior) Finance
Manager, you will own the full reporting cycle across our European
entities — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of
financial information as we scale. You’ll work closely with external
accounting partners in multiple countries and oversee monthly
shareholder reporting. Take ownership & drive the month-end closing
process by preparing and reviewing key accounting information and
collaborating closely with external accountants to finalize the
monthly financial records. Prepare monthly accruals. Support in
preparing monthly shareholder reporting (e.g. OPEX, Vehicle P&L).
Manage communications with external accounting offices in Italy,
Netherlands, Poland, Belgium, France, and Spain. Assist external
accountants with preparation of annual reports and third-party audits.
Prepare & issue client invoices, track payment status and proactively
follow up on overdue payments. Continuously improve, streamline and
automate finance processes to drive scalability of the finance
function. What That Looks Like In the first 3–6 months: Ramp Up
Quickly: Become fully onboarded into JUNA’s finance systems and
tools, building a solid understanding of our entity structure and
reporting flows. Own Core Processes: Independently complete your first
solo month-end close accurately and on time. Build Key Relationships:
Establish reliable, trust-based working relationships with our
external accounting offices across Europe. After 12 months: Seamless
Collaboration: Work in sync with external accounting teams across all
JUNA entities, ensuring smooth coordination and minimal friction.
Trusted Owner: Be recognized as a proactive, reliable owner of the
full reporting cycle and balance sheet — the go-to person for
financial accuracy and compliance. Process Champion: Have identified
and implemented improvements to finance workflows, contributing
meaningfully to JUNA’s operational scalability. Your profile What
you bring: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field,
coupled with 7+ years of professional experience in a relevant role.
Comfort working with external accounting partners across multiple
jurisdictions. Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems;
experience with consolidation tools is a plus. Professional fluency in
English required; German at B2 level or above. Who you are: Sharp and
detail-oriented — you catch errors before they become problems and
take pride in numerical accuracy. Proactive and structured — you
manage your workload independently and flag issues early rather than
waiting to be asked. Reliable under deadlines — you understand that
close cycles have hard stops and you plan accordingly. Analytical
mindset — you don’t just process numbers, you understand what they
mean and can explain variances clearly. Collaborative spirit — you
work well with external partners and internal stakeholders across
different countries and functions. Bonus points if you have:
Experience with multi-entity set-up. Exposure to scaling finance
functions in a startup or fast-growth environment. Familiarity with
IFRS in addition to HGB. Experience with MOSS, Zoho Books and Atlar.
Why us? Leadership and Innovation: Work with a pioneering team
dedicated to transforming road logistics and contributing to a
sustainable future. Autonomy and Impact: We value innovation and give
you the freedom to grow in our team to make a significant impact.
Sustainability: Join a company where your work directly contributes to
reducing carbon emissions in logistics. Benefits : Join a great team
in our dog-friendly, hybrid work model with an office located at the
heart of Kreuzberg, where you’ll enjoy a relaxed, no-micromanagement
culture, regular company events, access to Urban Sports Club and L&D
budget, and an office stocked with snacks and drinks to keep you
energized. Our Company Values Think outside the truck: challenge the
internal-only status quo, prototype fast. Impact, not activity: cut
through noise, prioritize what actually matters. Own it: end-to-end
roadmap ownership, no safety net. Collaboration drives the core: daily
work with engineers, CEO, and CTO. Customer in the driver's seat:
internal or external, understand what they need. --- At JUNA, we value
authenticity, humility, and potential — so even if you don’t check
every box, we encourage you to apply. We know that diverse
backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences are what drive true
innovation. Our team is collaborative, international, and always
evolving. Come as you are — we’re excited to meet you and
hopefully welcome you on our journey to transform the logistics
industry across Europe. If you require accommodation during the hiring
process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to
mikaela.roennkvist@juna.com. Please only contact this email for
accommodation purposes.

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,
detail-oriented and experienced Senior HR Manager (m/f/d) to join our
team in Berlin. This role will be responsible for leading key people,
compliance, and governance activities across the employee lifecycle,
ensuring that HR practices are legally compliant, operationally
effective, and aligned with organisational objectives. Acting as a
trusted advisor to managers and employees, the role provides expert
guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and
European regulations while promoting a safe, healthy, and engaging
workplace. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external
partners, and legal advisors, the Senior HR Manager identifies and
mitigates people-related risks, maintains strong governance
frameworks, and contributes to a positive employee experience across
the organisation. This position is ideal for an experienced HR
professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements
where applicable. Manage employee relations cases, including
disciplinary procedures, grievances, performance-related matters, and
workplace concerns. Partner with external legal advisors when
required. Compliance, Audits & Risk Management Conduct regular
internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR
operations-focused role. Strong knowledge of German labour law,
employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements. Experience
managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven
experience conducting HR audits and implementing compliance
initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data
management. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing
organization. Previous involvement in HR transformation, process
improvement, or digitalization projects. Experience working with audit
frameworks, compliance reviews, and risk management processes. Key
Competencies Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential
information. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
Strong project management and organisational skills. Collaborative and
customer-focused approach. What We Offer Opportunity to shape and
improve HR operations in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and
international team culture. Professional development and learning
opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexible
working arrangements. A people-first workplace focused on inclusion,

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking an
experienced Head of Academies (m/f/d) to provide operational
leadership for the European Raw Materials Academy and the European
Advanced Materials Academy. The European Raw Materials Academy and the
European Advanced Materials Academy are flagship European initiatives
that develop the skills and talent needed to strengthen Europe’s
competitiveness and industrial transformation in the raw and advanced
materials sectors. Reporting to the Director of Education & Skills,
the Head of Academies is responsible for translating strategic
priorities into operational delivery and ensuring the successful
implementation, scaling, and continuous improvement of both Academies.
The Head of Academies (m/f/d) provides direct line management to three
Senior Education Managers who collectively lead a multidisciplinary
team of approximately 20 colleagues. The ideal candidate combines
operational excellence with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven
ability to scale digital education initiatives. Success will be
measured through learner growth, program quality, operational
performance, and delivery against agreed Academy KPIs. Key
Accountabilities The Head of Academies is accountable for: 1.
Operational Delivery • Translate strategic priorities into
operational plans and ensure successful delivery against agreed
objectives, KPIs, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and
compliance requirements. • Establish and maintain effective
operational processes, governance, reporting, and continuous
improvement across both Academies. 2. Education Portfolio & Digital
Learning Platforms • Lead the operational management and continuous
improvement of the Academies' digital learning ecosystem, providing
recommendations to support strategic decision-making. • Drive
learner growth, program quality, and an excellent learner experience
through effective operational management and data-informed
decision-making. 3. Team Leadership • Lead, coach, and support the
Senior Managers responsible for Operations, Course Development, and
Partnerships. • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and
accountable multidisciplinary team. 4. Operational Performance &
Resources • Manage operational budgets within agreed frameworks,
supplier relationships, and procurement activities to support the
successful delivery of both Academies and ensure efficient and
compliant use of resources. • Develop, monitor, and report on
Academy KPIs, analyse operational performance, identify risks and
opportunities, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. 5.
Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with
internal teams and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment,
successful delivery, and sustainable growth of both Academies. What
We’re Looking For Required • Experience leading professional
learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,
Erasmus+, or the EIT ecosystem. • Understanding of quality
assurance, certification, credentials, and micro-credentials. •
Working knowledge of additional European languages. What We Offer •
The opportunity to lead the operational scaling of two flagship
European Academies with significant strategic impact. • Join a
committed, mission-driven team working at the intersection of
education, innovation, industry, and European policy. • Work with
leading European universities, industry partners, and public-sector
organisations to help shape the future workforce for the raw and
advanced materials sectors. • Hybrid working environment in Berlin.
• Competitive salary. Position Details • Location: Berlin,
Germany. • Contract: Full-time. • Duration: Fixed-term contract
until 2029, with the possibility of extension. • Travel: Occasional
travel within Europe is required. • Reports to: Director of
Education & Skills, EIT RawMaterials. Commitment to Diversity: EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D)

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]

Join our mission to help every child reach their full potential through developmentally respectful, relationship-based care. Apply now [https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=107895&tc=3-11]

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

We are looking for an IT Security Specialist to define security standards for two major data infrastructure projects in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region: (1) The Data Space Project (https://www.health-life-sciences.de/dataspace/)  of the Health + Life Science Alliance (http://www.health-life-sciences.de/) has recently been launched to develop a trusted research environment (TRE) for seven leading life sciences and biomedical research institutions in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region. (2) The German Human Genome-Phenome Archive (GHGA) (https://www.ghga.de/de/)  is part of the national program for research data infrastructures (NFDI) (https://www.nfdi.de/)  and has established a secure national omics data infrastructure, enabling the secondary use of human omics data in research.

These infrastructures are supporting the bioinformatics community with software tools for secure data/metadata storage, interactive data portals with data visualization, and streamlined data deposition and acquisition solutions. Prof. Oliver Stegle is coordinating GHGA at the DKFZ and representing the Data Space project for the DKFZ in close collaboration with the other Health + Life Science Alliance member institutions Heidelberg University, European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL), Central Institute of Mental Health, Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, Heidelberg University Hospital and University Hospital Mannheim.

In order to develop the Data Space Trusted Research Environment (TRE) and the GHGA platform into a state-of-the-art infrastructure for the secure handling and analysis of genome data, we are seeking with immediate effect an IT Security Specialist.

Job description:

We are looking for a team member with substantial experience in information security and risk governance. Your role will be instrumental in technical and organizational decision-making for the Data Space and GHGA projects and will ensure compliance with modern standards for both infrastructures. You will be part of two tightly connected teams spanning cloud engineers, data stewards and interdisciplinary researchers with the joint mission of enabling the secure sharing of sensitive biomedical data for the scientific research community. You will have a diverse set of tasks, shaping the IT infrastructure of the Data Space TRE from the start, while also managing the IT security for the operation of the established GHGA Portal and upcoming new functionalities. Your expertise will help ensure the safe operation of the Data Space TRE and GHGA while also contributing to the development of standards in Germany and supporting their role in international efforts.

Your responsibilities :

- Analysis and documentation of current operations with respect to IT security, identifying gaps and supporting continuous improvement
- Implementation and maintenance of a framework for risk and asset management, utilizing modern tools and standards
- Creation and maintenance of an Information Security Management System (ISMS)
- Implementation and maintenance of a program for security awareness that works across multiple communication channels
- Regular monitoring of risks through third-party interactors, such as used infrastructures or sub-contractors
- Provision of information security guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls
- Coordination of interaction with external expertise on legal and technical IT security topics

Your Profile:

Essential Expertise:

- Proven experience with core information security frameworks (BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001) and risk management methodologies
- Hands-on background in developing and implementing risk-mitigation plans, security policies, processes, and technical controls
- Solid understanding of GDPR compliance requirements and IT infrastructure fundamentals (e.g., networking, server roles, system architecture)
- Fluency in German and English to articulate technical requirements clearly and collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners
- Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to work independently, solve problems creatively, and drive initiatives to completion

Advantageous Qualifications:

- Knowledge of cloud security guardrails in multi-account environments (e.g., IAM, SCP, centralized logging, encryption, network isolation)
- CISSP certification or equivalent advanced security credential

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Katharina Deschler
Phone: +49 (0)6221/3878890

Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: October 2, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

Senior Developer (f/m/d) in SAP Cloud Integration

Date: 08/12/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you’ll build

You will build software for SAP Cloud Integration, which is SAP’s strategic integration platform. You will design, build, and deliver new features, with a growing focus on integrating AI into our product. This includes enhancing existing AI capabilities and applying AI to new use cases. You will integrate foundation models, build AI applications, develop agentic systems, and optimize inference. You will also help resolve customer incidents and leverage AI to improve internal workflows, including development processes.

SAP Cloud Integration is one of the fastest growing cloud services at SAP. Our 15,000 customers use our software to connect their SAP as well as non-SAP systems (like Finance, Human Resources, Supply Chain, E-Commerce, etc.). That way we enable many of the world’s largest enterprises to run their core business processes. However, our work is business agnostic and instead focuses on things like scalability, security, interoperability, reliability, availability, and performance.

What you bring

- This role is for experienced developers (5+ years).
- Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot.
- Significant practical experience with:
- integrating AI features into production systems
- leveraging AI-tools for coding, testing and analysis
- building cloud applications at scale
- several of the following: Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry, Kafka, databases, SQL, and Jenkins.
- University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, a Natural Science, or similar – or equivalent practical experience.
- Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).

Where you belong

Our team culture is very collaborative and supportive. While we value the flexibility of remote work, we come together in our Walldorf office at least three days a week to connect, collaborate, and build as a team.

We’re looking for people who bring fresh ideas and a proactive mindset - those who want to contribute, learn, and grow with us.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

jobs.description:
About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead the development of the AI-based “Scientific Brain” research platform, including the overall construction of AI systems; apply large language models (LLMs) to design and optimize model architectures, carry out model training, and deploy the integrated AI platform.
2. Utilize robotic technologies to perform high-throughput experiments for the rapid synthesis and screening of a vast array of material candidates, accelerating the discovery of high-performance materials.
3. Analyze experimental data from material characterization techniques; correlate material properties with catalytic performance to guide the optimization of catalyst formulations and synthesis methods, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency.
4. Apply AI-driven computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level; simulate adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways of reactants, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.
5. Continuously explore and apply new AI algorithms and techniques to optimize predictive models and improve catalyst development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of advanced catalysts.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field
2. Several years of relevant professional experience in AI system development, platform engineering, or a comparable field
3. Solid experience in developing AI systems or scalable platforms, with sound knowledge of distributed system architectures and large-scale data processing
4. Proficiency in Python, Java, or Go
5. Practical experience with common AI frameworks and infrastructure tools, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker
6. Good knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (such as AWS or Azure), and containerized deployment technologies
7. Additional academic or professional background in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering is considered an asset
8. Knowledge of or experience in energy, energy storage, or low-carbon technology applications is highly desirable
9. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment: Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe

Application process:

Please send your application documents by email to

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

Subject line: “[Position] – [Your Name]”.

Your application should include:

- CV (including information/listing of representative research projects for R&D positions)
- University certificates / transcripts (if available)
- Reference letters from previous employers (if available)

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your data for the purpose of the recruitment process.

All document will be treated confidentially in accordance with GDPR. We retain applications for up to six months after completion of the recruitment process, unless you give explicit consent for longer storage.

For questions regarding the position or the application process, please contact our Recruiting Team:

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

In this role, you will optimize data workflows to enable advanced analytics, AI, and Digital Twin use cases, proactively monitor and resolve data integration issues across multiple systems, and work hand in hand with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and future-ready data solutions.

Your work will enable scalable, secure, and high-quality data solutions that power initiatives like Digital Twins, predictive analytics, and process optimization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Design and implement robust data pipelines for structured and unstructured data
* Ensure data availability and integrity for critical business applications and analytics
* Support integration of core systems (ERP, PLM, SCM) into the data platform
* Enable AI and advanced analytics by providing clean, well-modeled datasets and drive automation and performance improvements in data workflows
* Contribute to the development of STG’s data architecture and governance framework
* Collaborate with architects on cloud-based solutions and modern data architectures

What You Bring

* University Degree or similar education as well as several years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, and data integration
* Strong skills in SQL and experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop) combined with knowledge of data modeling, data governance, and best practices for data quality
* Hands-on experience with cloud-based data architectures and data lake architectures; experience with AWS and Snowflake are a plus
* Experience with Alteryx and Python or similar programming languages for data processing
* Familiarity with API integration and event-driven architectures, experience with MLOps and enabling AI/ML pipelines would be a plus
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken

About the Team

In our Transformation of Industry division, we offer comprehensive digital portfolio solutions in the oil and gas sector and other process industries comprising rotating equipment, electrification, and solutions for the Subsea business. Our customers are supported with sustainable and mission-critical products, solutions, and services.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Program Manager (w/f/d) Scholar Support & Quality, München (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: The SOS Children's Villages worldwide Hermann-Gmeiner-Fonds Deutschland e.V. is an independent, non-denominational children's rights organization. With its headquarters in Munich and offices in Berlin and Düsseldorf, the organization has been supporting the global projects of SOS Children's Villages since 1963. 200 employees are committed to the vision of "For a world that lets you grow". With almost 3,000 programs in over 130 countries, the organization offers help to children, young people and families in need through education, medical care and family strengthening. The focus is on strengthening the family, sustainability, children's rights and cultural sensitivity.   To support our Scholarships & Educational Development team in our Munich office, we are looking for a (Junior) Program Manager - Scholar Support & Quality (m/f/d) on a full time basis. Your tasks As (Junior) Program Manager - Scholar Support & Quality, take operational ownership of scholar support, program quality, and MEAL within the Global Scholarship Program (GSP). You work closely with scholars, colleagues, and external partners to ensure that scholars receive appropriate support, cases are well documented, program standards are upheld, risks and concerns are managed appropriately, and evidence and learning are systematically used to strengthen the program. This includes the following tasks: Program Quality, MEAL & Impact: Develop & manage a safeguarding-informed GSP quality and MEAL framework. Coordinate data collection, analysis and reporting and ensure findings are translated into concrete program improvements. Coordinate impact measurement approaches, including SROI, and lead the preparation of the GSP annual report. Provide administrative support to the team Scholar Support & Documentation: Manage and coordinate the scholar support process throughout their journey. Maintain and update scholar information as well as all relevant documents (communications, reports, transcripts) in appropriate databases and tools. Schedule check-ins & respond promptly to general inquiries from students and stakeholders. Serve as the primary contact for scholar inquiries on YouthLinks Community (an internal communication platform), by coordinating, developing, and posting relevant information, guidance, and support materials for scholars. Prepare reports as required        Your profile You have successfully completed studies in social work, psychology, youth development, social sciences, education, international development, public policy or a related field. You bring initial relevant professional experience in one or more areas such as student or youth support, program quality, monitoring and evaluation. Skills in MHPSS are an advantage. You are highly organized and approach routine and recurring tasks with diligence and understand their importance for effective scholar support, monitoring and program management. You are proactive and bring forward innovative ideas for improvements. You are a team player with a positive attitude, hands-on-mentality and get things done. You are flexible in navigating a complex and fast changing environment and have the ability to prioritize effectively when faced with multiple requests. You have effective communication skills with excellent command of English. Another foreign language such as Spanish, Portuguese, German, Arabic or French is an advantage. You have very good skills in MS-Office, Adobe & Canva. Additional computer skills are a plus. We offer A diverse, inspiring, and responsible role in a professionally managed, internationally active non-profit organization·       Opportunities for professional development and the chance to be part of an international network An open ear for new ideas and impulses, and the opportunity to help shape our work Work-life balance through flexible working hours, compensatory time off, and the option to work remotely (including from abroad) Numerous benefits like employer funded pension and financial allowance for childcare Meal allowance, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, subsidized EGYM Wellpass Interesting further training opportunities SOS Children's Villages adhere to strict child safeguarding principles and maintain a zero-tolerance policy towards sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse. Therefore, during recruitment, we not only consider personal and professional suitability, but also the willingness to act according to our child protection guidelines and values. We require an extended police clearance certificate upon employment. Diversity is important to us. At SOS Children's Villages Worldwide, we actively stand against racism and discrimination, and we welcome applications from people regardless of their ethnic, national, or social background, gender, disability, age, or sexual orientation. If you are excited about this challenging role, we look forward to receiving your application soon! SOS-Kinderdörfer weltweit  Ridlerstr. 55 80339 München

jobs.employer_name: Max-Planck-Institut für die Physik des Lichts
jobs.description:
About us

The Max-Planck-Zentrum für Physik und Medizin (MPZPM) is an interdisciplinary joint research center of the Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL), Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU), and Universitätsklinikum Erlangen (UKER). Research at MPZPM addresses fundamental questions in medicine, aiming to understand living systems, biological processes, and their pathological changes from a novel physical perspective.

Facility Leader - Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility at MPZPM
Core Facilities (CF) at MPZPM provide cutting-edge technologies and form an essential part of the center’s scientific infrastructure. The Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility is equipped with state-of-the-art microfabrication technologies housed within a cleanroom at MPZPM. LoC can also draw on the capabilities of another nanofabrication cleanroom facility at MPL. The unit supports researchers in developing advanced microfluidic chips, microtools and physiologically relevant microenvironments for studies at the interface of physics and medicine. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Facility Head to manage and further develop the Lab-on-a-Chip facility. You will oversee daily operations, ensure safe and efficient laboratory workflows, support scientific users from diverse backgrounds and contribute to the design and development of innovative methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Management

Lead, mentor, and support scientific and technical staff, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team.
Oversee facility operations, including planning, budgeting, maintenance, and strategic development.
Train and support users from diverse scientific backgrounds.

Technical Expertise & Scientific Support

Ensure reliable operation of cleanroom infrastructure and microfabrication equipment.
Provide expert guidance in microfabrication, microfluidics, and lab-on-a-chip system development.
Contribute to the development of new microstructured materials, microfluidic chips, and advanced LoC technologies.

Innovation & Development

Support interdisciplinary research projects and facilitate knowledge transfer across scientific fields.
Develop novel microfluidics-based methodologies and provide SOPs to ensure reliable and reproducible use.
Propose and discuss organizational and infrastructure improvements with the MPZPM board, focusing on optimized workflows, state-of-the-art technologies, and strategic upgrades aligned with the institute’s priorities.
You bring:

MSc or PhD in physics, biophysics, chemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or a related field.
Experience in managing laboratories, particularly cleanrooms, including staff supervision and operation of microfabrication workflows.
Strong organizational, leadership, and project-management skills, with a track record of building or expanding scientific infrastructure.
Expertise in developing microfluidic technologies.
Capability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across scientific disciplines. English is the primary working language; knowledge of German is advantageous.
Experience in technology transfer, device development, or industry collaboration is a plus.

Ideal Technical Competencies (some of the following):

Microfabrication & Lithography: photolithography, soft lithography, micropatterning of rigid and soft materials, biomolecule patterning via microcontact printing or LIMA photopatterning.
Microfluidics & Lab-on-a-Chip Systems: design, production, and integration of microfluidic chips with fluidic, optical and electronic components.
Soft Material Microstructuring: hydrogels, droplet microfluidics, and other soft materials relevant to biomedical applications.
3D structuring using Digital Light Processing (DLP) and Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM).

The Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science (Max Planck Gesellschaft, MPG) is a self-governing scientific organization funded by the Federal and State Governments. It conducts basic research in the fields of natural sciences, the humanities and the social sciences in 85 institutes and research units in Germany and abroad.

The MPG consists of three sections: the Biology and Medicine Section, the Chemistry, Physics and Technology Section and the Human Sciences Section. Each section has a Scientific Scouting Officer who supports the respective section and its institutes in identifying the next generation of leading researchers.

For the Human Sciences Section, the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG are now seeking a:

Scientific Scouting Officer (all genders) -

80% part-time initially, with a potential full-time transition effective 1 January 2029

(Reference Number 63/26)

to start as early as possible.

The Section includes a range of disciplines, notably the History of Art, Anthropology, Demography, Economics, the History of Science, Law, Neurosciences, Political Sciences, Psychology, and Sociology.

Proactive and systematic identification of outstanding scientists to support the Human Sciences Section and its Core and Appointment Commissions
Building and analyzing candidate pools, generating appropriate statistics
Using various talent acquisition tools, including but not limited to internet sourcing, data mining, social media, networking at national and international conferences, as well as other creative methods to identify outstanding candidates
Analyzing candidate lists generated through nomination calls
Implementing, maintaining and further developing candidate databases together with the two Scouting Officers of the other section
Attending international conferences, participating in public outreach to promote the MPG
Complementing the current scouting team and actively participating in constantly developing the team’s scouting concept, tackling human sciences-oriented as well as interdisciplinary scouting projects

Doctoral degree in one of the scientific disciplines of the Human Sciences Section and several years of postdoctoral experience
Education and/or postdoctoral research abroad, ideally for several years
In-depth knowledge of the German and international research landscape (including organizational and research-specific framework conditions)
Proven scientific track record and demonstrated knowledge of the respective scientific community
General interest in a broad range of scientific subjects covered in the Human Sciences Section and ability to quickly familiarize yourself with new areas of research
Solution-oriented, service-driven, creative and open-minded working style
Excellent proficiency in English (written and spoken, level C1-C2) and good proficiency in German (minimum level B2)
Excellent interpersonal communication and networking skills, in order to interact with and coordinate partners with diverse professional and multicultural backgrounds
Experience in working with AI applications or a willingness to learn how to use such systems
Willingness to adopt flexible working hours, as well as taking part in regular business travel in Germany and abroad
Experience in scouting/recruiting scientists would be desirable

You will gain fascinating insights into the outstanding research at our Max Planck Institutes.
You will help to identify the next generation of outstanding scientists for the MPG by directly interacting with its leadership and directors.
As a member of the Section Office, you will cooperate with the department "Institutes" at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG.
You will obtain an excellent overview of the entire spectrum of scientific administration and the structure of the German research landscape.
